facts.fact: The mobile number can be updated at any Aadhaar Enrolment Centre
facts.quote: You can update your mobile number in Aadhaar by visiting any of the Aadhaar Enrolment Centre or through postman, for which no document or old mobile number is required.

facts.fact: It can also be updated through the postman
facts.quote: You can update your mobile number in Aadhaar by visiting any of the Aadhaar Enrolment Centre or through postman, for which no document or old mobile number is required.

facts.fact: India Post Payments Bank's doorstep banking service lists 'Mobile number update in AADHAAR'
facts.quote: Third-party Services Life Insurance General Insurance Mutual Funds Financial Services Mobile number update in AADHAAR Digital Life Certificate Generation
facts.note: Audit 28 Oct: reworded as in MT-02 #2; the quote lists the service but does not say it is the 'postman channel' (coordinator).

facts.fact: The Aadhaar app is also a channel: it offers Mobile Number Update
facts.quote: Presently, the Aadhaar app offers various services like - Mobile Number Update, Address Update, Biometric lock/unlock, Selective Sharing of Aadhaar Verifiable Credential, check Authentication History, download e-Aadhaar, share Contact Card, Track my request, etc.
facts.note: An older answer on the same FAQ page still says 'Mobile update is not permitted through online mode' (the myAadhaar portal); the Aadhaar app FAQ block (content published 30 Apr 2026) lists Mobile Number Update.

facts.fact: No document or old mobile number is needed
facts.quote: You can update your mobile number in Aadhaar by visiting any of the Aadhaar Enrolment Centre or through postman, for which no document or old mobile number is required.

facts.fact: Fee: Rs 75 when the mobile number is updated as a separate demographic update
facts.quote: (2) Demographic update: Update of enrolled name, gender, date of birth, address, mobile number or email address, or any combination of the same (i) If done at the same time with biometric update: Free (ii) If done separately: ₹75

facts.fact: It is free only when done at the same time as a biometric update
facts.quote: (2) Demographic update: Update of enrolled name, gender, date of birth, address, mobile number or email address, or any combination of the same (i) If done at the same time with biometric update: Free (ii) If done separately: ₹75

facts.fact: A free Mandatory Biometric Update must be a stand-alone transaction and cannot be clubbed with another update
facts.quote: # Mandatory Biometric Update (MBU) shall be stand-alone transaction only; it may not be clubbed with any other transaction

summary: All confirmed: centre, postman (IPPB doorstep lists Aadhaar mobile update) and Aadhaar app; no document or old number; Rs 75 separately, free with a biometric update, MBU stand-alone.
